div.style: color: rgb(20, 33, 61) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center; width: 560px;

span.p:
S1 Life and Career Plan (interview with Virgil)
Why: every programme is scored against YOUR life, money and constraints
Output: your life plan

div.style: color: rgb(61, 42, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(20, 33, 61) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center; width: 560px;

span.p:
S2 Study and Pathway Map (interview + benchmark scout)
Why: defines what fit means: what you will learn, and the people, labs, industry partners and internships that lead where you want
Output: pathway map + 3 benchmark examples

div.style: color: rgb(61, 42, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(20, 33, 61) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
S0 Orientation
Know the journey; jot down your life plan and study interests
Output: your notes

div.style: color: rgb(20, 33, 61) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
S3 Scope and Agent Brief
Why: decides which countries, how deep, and what funded means
Output: search plan + agent brief

div.style: color: rgb(20, 33, 61) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
S4 to S6 Search waves (one research agent per country)
Path A: programme-first. Path B: people- and partner-first.
Saves a JSON file after every record, so nothing is lost
Output: one file per country

div.style: color: rgb(20, 33, 61) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center; width: 560px;

span.p:
S7 Triage
Follow-ups where gaps matter; stop where the answer cannot change; cross-country funding scans

div.style: color: rgb(20, 33, 61) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
S8 Merge and Verify
Scripts merge and score; an independent agent fact-checks a sample

div.style: color: rgb(15, 51, 32) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
S9 Deliverables
Options Rundown (your decision document)
Due-Diligence One-Pager (proof of breadth and verification)

div.style: color: rgb(36, 26, 77) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

Usage limit hit at any point?
Stop safely: nothing is lost.
